same_box_candidate: Preserve all 37 generation-2 members and add all 32 corners with calibration coordinates at +/-0.5 but shape/phase coordinates at +/-1, if a trusted failure supports this interior-shell design.
dispersion_candidate: Preserve all 37 generation-2 members; add the canonical 32-run six-factor half-fraction whose six signs have product +1. The first five factors use the existing 2%,2%,0.01,0.01,0.03 widths; dispersion is the sixth factor. All six factors are balanced; every projection onto up to five factors is complete. This is an explicit finite design, NOT certification of every corner or every interior point of a six-dimensional box.
selection_rule: Prefer a trustworthy same-box interior failure. Otherwise use the smaller dispersion width that gives a reference-validated failure of the selected best official champion inside the canonical half-fraction, while fully referenced dispersion-only controls pass. Do not change parity to include a desired failure.
resource_rule: Benchmark the complete reference traversal, with early rejection disabled only for measurement, under the final declared resource limits before sealing. This is passing-path-equivalent work, not a claim that a failing calibration witness passed the task.
